records.name: DMLT Colleges (Various)

notes: Normal TLS verification failed due to the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs were retried with curl --insecure as permitted.

records.name: Indian Institute of Petroleum Dehradun

notes: Research institute with postgraduate research access; keep outside ordinary college ranking unless the app explicitly includes research institutes.
